title: Reaching for a star
excerpt: A little cat, a night sky, and the kind of wish I used to sketch in my notebook.
body:
Night skies have followed me since the old drawing account. A small companion looking up felt honest — curious, not grand.

This acrylic keeps that mood: warm darks, a glowing star, and a cat that wants something just out of reach. I painted it for the stall the same way I used to draw for Instagram. Soft, a bit dreamy, and made with love.

The artwork file is the original. No crop for style, no filter.
